signin.title: Pocket Money
signin.tagline: Pocket money for kids, kept in your own Google Sheet.
signin.permission: Sign-in only asks for access to the sheet this app creates. It cannot see the rest of your Drive.
signin.sampleHome: The family home screen: one account card per kid with balance and goal progress
signin.sampleKid: A kid's screen: the goal, how many paydays to go, the balance and recent money
signin.bankBody: Record allowance, gifts and spending. No real money moves; the app keeps the score.
signin.goalBody: Their balance, and how many Fridays until the skateboard. Allowance lands by itself on payday.
signin.sheetBody: Everything lives in one Google Sheet in your Drive. No server, no account with us, open source.

bootstrap.noFamilyHint: Create a new family, or open a sheet another parent shared with you. Invited? Use the link from the invitation email, or choose Open existing and pick the shared sheet under "Shared with me".
bootstrap.join: You were invited to a family
